title: One Shade, Many Ways
caption:
A single eyeshadow can do more than it seems.

Spread a thin layer across the whole lid,
and it becomes a soft, natural shadow.
Add a little more along the lash line,
and the shape of the eye becomes clearer.

The same shade can change your look
with just two things:
how wide you spread it,
and how many times you layer it.

Before adding another color,
try what one shade can do.
